items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Fats Navarro, it‘s too bad, he went away, Fats had it man, he had good range, and [laughs] good solos, Fats Navarro was something else.

ctx.x: How about Fats Navarro? Fats, Fats?

Fats Navarro, it‘s too bad, he went away, Fats had it man, he had good range, and [laughs] good solos, Fats Navarro was something else. I think Fats might have did something too that took him away from here so young because I don‘t know why he went away from here. Do you know?
I think he died young of tuberculosis.
